formulae.frequency: genre occurrence count / full positive-history length
formulae.persistence: number of four chronological bins containing genre / 4
formulae.recency: mean of 1-based occurrence position / full history length
formulae.cooccurrence: N(i,g) / sqrt(N(i)*N(g)); 0 if either marginal count is 0
formulae.guard: trigger iff new overlap < previous accepted overlap
formulae.coherence: mean binary nonempty genre overlap over adjacent pairs in intermediates+target
formulae.history_reuse: resolved non-target history occurrences / max(all non-target path occurrences,1)
formulae.PHRR: runner alias of HistoryReuseRate; no independent formula

controlled_experiment.offline_feedback: all parser-valid and guard-valid intermediates accepted

implementation_design_discrepancies.issue: Prompt labels its interest payload as a multi-interest profile but receives only Top-5 rows, not the full genre table.
Earlier intended description allowed broader candidate support tiers when direct support is small; frozen code implements DIRECT only and no fallback threshold/tier.
Guard is documented conceptually as pre-add stopping, while code appends through the parent planner and then rolls the item back.
Guard-blocked item is removed from used_ids; immediate terminal state prevents practical re-entry in this implementation.
PHRR in experiment outputs is an alias of HistoryReuseRate, not an independently implemented metric.
